content:
1. In the Datadog UI, navigate to the Monitor section.
2. Click on the "New Monitor" button to create a new monitor.
3. Select "Create a new monitor" and choose "Metric" as the monitor type.
4. In the "Define the metric, tags, and threshold" section, select the "kubernetes.containers.last_state.terminated" metric.
5. Set the appropriate aggregation method (e.g. sum) and time window for the metric.
6. Define the threshold for the metric that will trigger the monitor when it detects an OOM event (e.g. >= 1).
7. In the "Notify your team" section, configure the notification settings based on your preferences.
8. In the "Additional settings" section, set the "Query window" to a value that allows the monitor to check for the metric periodically.
9. Save the monitor with a descriptive name and enable it.
10. Your monitor is now set up to detect OOM events in containers based on the "kubernetes.containers.last_state.terminated" metric. The monitor will trigger alerts when the metric reports a value of 1 or higher.
